item.title: I visited Amsterdam for the first time with my family — here are 4 things that surprised me most about our trip
item.description: Our first trip to Amsterdam as a family was great, but there are mistakes I wish we avoided and tips I wish we knew before we got to the Netherlands.

item.title: Interior designers share 6 living-room trends that'll be huge this year, and 2 on their way out
item.description: We asked interior designers about 2026 living-room trends. Color capping, antique decor, and mirror TVs are in, and harsh overhead lighting is out.

item.title: More kids than ever will be banned from social media this year
item.description: Afters years of talk, governments in Australia, France, and more are taking action to ban social-media for kids. Some warn of unintended effects.

item.title: What it's like visiting the island of St. Barts — a beloved party spot for billionaires and their superyachts
item.description: St. Barthelemy, or St. Barts, is a French-speaking Caribbean island with beaches and high-end shops where billionaires like Jeff Bezos vacation.

item.title: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani is inaugurated, vowing to replace 'rugged individualism with the warmth of collectivism'
item.description: In his inauguration speech, Mayor Zohran Mamdani doubled down on campaign promises, pledging to "govern expansively and audaciously."

item.title: AI boom threatens to push smartphone, PC prices higher in 2026
item.description: AI data centers are soaking up key components, raising the risk of higher smartphone and PC prices for consumers in 2026.

item.title: 19 states just raised their minimum wage. See which states pay the most.
item.description: See how your state ranks — from New York to Hawaii — as 19 states raise the minimum wage for 2026.

item.title: Texas Tech gambled on its 'underdog' head coach Joey McGuire. Here's what stood out during his interview and landed him the job.
item.description: How Joey McGuire won over Texas Tech with bold outreach and a seven-step plan to jump-start winning as the program's next head coach.

item.title: Kate Hudson, 46, says she doesn't need long workouts to feel good
item.description: "I danced. So, like if I'm not moving, I feel awful, you know?" Kate Hudson said.

item.title: LLMs and a chipmaking boom: Here's what Xi Jinping said about China's AI wins in his New Year's address
item.description: Xi Jinping said AI models and breakthroughs in local chip development have boosted China "in a race to the top."
